description: This Java source file defines the GenericValue class, which handles persistence and relationships for generic entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, storing, removing, refreshing, and retrieving related entities, as well as utility functions and nested classes.

classes.name: GenericValue
classes.description: A class representing a generic entity value object that manages persistence and relationships for any defined entity in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: NullGenericValue
classes.description: A nested static class representing a null or placeholder instance of GenericValue.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods to create new GenericValue instances from various inputs such as ModelEntity, Map, GenericValue, or GenericPK.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Instance method to create the entity in the persistent store via the delegator.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the current GenericValue in the persistent store.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current GenericValue from the persistent store.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue from the persistent store.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue from cache.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on relation name, with options for filtering, ordering, and caching.

methods.name: getRelatedMulti
methods.description: Retrieves related entities across a multi-to-multi relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity based on relation name, with optional caching.

methods.name: removeRelated
methods.description: Removes related entities based on relation name.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Returns a dummy primary key for a related entity.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of the GenericValue.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name; overridden in NullGenericValue.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation; overridden in NullGenericValue.

methods.name: getStackTraceAsString
methods.description: Returns the current thread's stack trace as a string.
